_about: The action guard's payment rules for EVERY site (scripts/guard/guard.mjs), checked before a site's own pack and also on sites that have no pack, in every browser NAVI opens (recording, rehearsal, the off-camera ready state, the explorer, the start-page check, login checks). A site's pack adds its own ways of paying (X's Premium operations, Whop's processCheckout...). Payment processors are matched on the addresses that pay, save a card or change a subscription, not on every request to them: Stripe's own background reports (q.stripe.com/csp-report, m.stripe.com, r.stripe.com) stopped FG08 on Whop's checkout page on 14 Nov 2026 when every POST to Stripe was blocked. A match is a regex on host, path, method, op (operation name), kind or body; all given parts must match. Only requests that can change something (not GET, HEAD, OPTIONS) are checked.

ignore.label: PayPal's button logs (a page showing a PayPal button)

dangerous.reason: paying, saving a card or subscribing (a real charge)

match.label: Stripe: a payment, a card, a subscription, an invoice or the billing portal
Stripe: confirming, paying or capturing anything (Stripe Checkout's /v1/payment_pages/<id>/confirm)
PayPal, Venmo and Braintree: any change
Apple: an address that pays, buys or subscribes
Apple: Apple Pay and store hosts (apple-pay-gateway, buy.itunes...)
Shopify's card vault (only ever used to pay)
Adyen, Checkout.com and Square: a payment, a card or a session payment
Paddle, Lemon Squeezy and pay-later services: paying or approving
any site: an address that places an order or pays
any site: an operation that places an order or pays
